alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, and a pale blue mug sits on the right. A speech bubble says tea time. Then rinse it first, and steam rises while the mug turns warm orange. Then wait for it with narrowed eyes, then tip it out as the steam stops. Then now the tea, with steam again, and still hot with happy eyes and a pulse. At the end the steam fades, the mug turns pale blue again and the figure settles exactly where it started, so the loop is seamless. The text stays: me warming the mug before the tea.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
